text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having missed out on 1st place in the 
Japanese Derby, Narita Brian swallowed her 
frustration and vowed to become even 
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Hishi Amazon had achieved the 
second Tiara crown. The two decided to 
settle things at the Arima Kinen after the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian lets her fighting spirit boil 
over. First, to seize the Kikuka Sho, the 
final leg of the Classic Triple Crown—!
